name: brain-marketplace
description: The Brain — a git-backed, agent-queryable knowledge substrate (Graphify code graph + Obsidian-style concept wiki + the graph→wiki→raw query rule). Infrastructure that any Claude Code session depends on; orchestrators are consumers, never the reverse.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Standalone knowledge-substrate plugin: the 3-step graph→wiki→raw query rule, /save /resume /freshness /wiki-ingest skills, a self-gating graph-before-grep hook, the vault scaffolding + bin scripts, and a multi-vault registry for routing a project to the right brain (personal vs team).
